campuses.title: Villa Guastavillani Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус BBS — резиденция XVI века в холмах Bologna, 10 минут от центра. Все аудитории, лаборатории и study rooms в самом здании виллы.

paragraphs: Bologna Business School (BBS) is the graduate business school of the University of Bologna — the oldest university in continuous operation in the Western world, founded in 1088. BBS was established in 2000 as Alma Graduate School and re-branded as Bologna Business School in 2014. The school awards degrees through the Università di Bologna and is structured as Fondazione Bologna University Business School.

BBS is located at Villa Guastavillani, a restored 16th-century residence in the Bolognese hills, ten minutes from the city centre. The campus brings together classrooms, labs, study rooms and common spaces inside the historic villa itself, blending Renaissance architecture with a modern executive-education environment.

The portfolio is organised in four families: Global MBA with five specialised tracks (AI and Manufacturing; Design, Fashion and Luxury Goods; Food and Wine; Supercars, Superbikes and Motorsports; Sustainability and Innovation); Professional Masters in management, finance, data science, AI, marketing, HR and sustainability; Executive Masters and the Executive MBA / Hybrid MBA in both Italian and English editions; and Open Programs for executives.

BBS is internationally accredited and cultivates a strongly international cohort, with MBA classes drawing students from across Europe, the Americas, Asia and Africa. The school's 'Initiative for Sustainable Society and Business' and its proximity to Italy's Motor Valley, food/wine clusters and Made-in-Italy supply chains are core distinctives that translate into industry-immersive learning across all flagship MBA tracks.
paragraphsRu: Bologna Business School (BBS) — graduate business school при Università di Bologna, старейшем непрерывно действующем университете западного мира (основан в 1088 году). BBS открыта в 2000 году как Alma Graduate School и ребрендирована в Bologna Business School в 2014-м. Дипломы выдаёт Università di Bologna, юридически школа оформлена как Fondazione Bologna University Business School.

BBS располагается в Villa Guastavillani — отреставрированной резиденции XVI века в холмах Bologna, в 10 минутах от центра города. На территории виллы собраны аудитории, лаборатории, study rooms и общие пространства — ренессансная архитектура в режиме современного executive-кампуса.

Программы делятся на четыре направления: Global MBA с пятью специализациями (AI and Manufacturing; Design, Fashion and Luxury Goods; Food and Wine; Supercars, Superbikes and Motorsports; Sustainability and Innovation); Professional Masters по management, finance, data science, AI, marketing, HR и sustainability; Executive Masters и Executive MBA / Hybrid MBA в итальянской и английской редакциях; Open Programs для руководителей.

BBS аккредитована на международном уровне и удерживает сильную международную когорту: на MBA учатся студенты из Европы, Америк, Азии и Африки. Initiative for Sustainable Society and Business, близость к итальянской Motor Valley, food/wine кластерам и Made-in-Italy supply chains — ключевые отличительные черты школы и основа индустриального погружения на всех флагманских MBA-треках.
